---
name: Feature request
about: An idea for the CLI, templates, or skills
title: "one-line proposal"
labels: enhancement
---

## Use case

Describe the situation you are actually in, as a story rather than a feature name.

- What were you trying to do with the governance docs?
- What did you run, and where did you get stuck or have to do something by hand?
- How often does this come up — once per project, per batch, per session?

A concrete failing workflow is worth more than a general wish.

## Current workaround

What do you do today instead? If nothing works, say so — that changes the priority.

## Proposed change

What should exist that does not exist now? Command, template section, skill step, or check
rule — whichever it is. Sketch the smallest version, not the full product.

## Why it belongs in this kit

specgate is a governance kit for repositories AI agents work in: plain markdown, zero runtime
dependencies, offline after install, add-only, ask-first. Does this proposal fit those
constraints? If it needs a server, a database, a network call, or editing an existing file,
say how you would square that.

## Out of scope here

Suggestions already covered by the README's known limitations — one writer at a time (no
cross-machine lock), no team panel in v1, and the check being advisory until you wire it —
are unlikely to move quickly. Point at the limitation instead of restating it.

## Anything else

Links, examples from other tools, drafts of the document section you have in mind.
